name: smwsprites-lantern
title: Lantern
description:
When this sprite spawns, it will decrease the screen brightness to a configurable amount. When it's shot by a fireball (Mario's or Yoshi's), it will light up for a short amount of time. If the extra bit is set, it will never go out.

Check the ASM file for configuration options.

Based on the lanterns in Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past. Demonstration video.
